title: {v} Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Sauté the {v} with the {spice} in an oven-safe pan until soft.
Whisk the eggs (about 2 to 3 per person) with salt and pepper and pour them over the veg. Dot with the {sauce}.
Cook on the stove for 2 minutes until the edges set, then bake 12 to 15 minutes, until the center is set and the eggs reach 160°F / 71°C.
Rest 5 minutes, slice, and serve with the {s}.
tip: More veg and fewer eggs per slice keeps it light, and herbs plus a little sharp cheese carry the flavor.
